provenance.title: Front cover, first edition of『鶉籠』(Uzura Kago), Shunyodo, January 1907 (Meiji 40) -- the collection volume containing the first book publication of『坊っちゃん』(Botchan)
provenance.collection: National Diet Library Digital Collections (dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/885509), mirrored to Wikimedia Commons as File:NDL885509 鶉籠 part1.pdf
provenance.licenceBasis: Commons file categorized PD-Japan and PD-scan (PD-Japan), extmetadata License=pd. Cross-checked against the NDL bibliographic record (dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/885509: 著者：夏目漱石（金之助）著, 出版者：春陽堂, 出版年月日：明40.1 -- Shunyodo, Meiji 40 = January 1907), matching Botchan's documented first-book-edition date (serialized in Hototogisu in 1906, then collected into this Shunyodo anthology on 1 January 1907).
